agent_answer.notes: The corpus contains exactly five papers (S001-S005), each comparing a no-retrieval baseline (B) against a retrieval-augmented generator (R) and reporting a factual-accuracy or hallucination metric. The answer to 'Does RAG improve the factual accuracy of LLM-generated answers?' is mixed and domain/task-dependent: RAG clearly improves factual accuracy in S001 (biomedical), S002 (legal, via a lower unsupported-answer rate) and S005 (scientific); it has no measurable effect in S004 (trivia); and it makes factual accuracy worse in S003 (medical, where R produces more hallucinations than B). Overall: improves in 3 of 5 papers, neutral in 1, harmful in 1.
